title: Replication Package: Social Dimensions in Livestock Digital Transformation: A Bibliometric and Adoption-Economics Analysis
description:
Complete replication package for a bibliometric and economic-synthesis study of livestock digital transformation research. Includes:

  • Python source code reproducing all bibliometric analyses, statistical tests, tables, and figures (PRISMA-screened dataset of 2,812 peer-reviewed articles, 2000–2026, retrieved from the Lens Scholarly Database);
  • An R/Bibliometrix script providing an independent cross-validation of the descriptive bibliometrics and producing Callon's strategic (thematic) map and a Sankey thematic-evolution diagram;
  • VOSviewer project files providing a third, independent cross-validation of the keyword co-occurrence network;
  • Raw and PRISMA-filtered bibliometric datasets;
  • Full documentation (codebook, data description, reproducibility checklist, and step-by-step replication guide).

The study tests whether social-dimension research (farmers, technology, policy, socioeconomic factors) in livestock digital-transformation research is structurally marginalised within the scientific literature or simply rare in prevalence, and synthesises recent peer-reviewed evidence on the scale-conditional economic returns to precision livestock technology adoption.

All known cross-tool discrepancies (a genuine citation tie, a source-count rounding difference, and a Louvain clustering determinism issue) are disclosed explicitly in the README rather than silently resolved, consistent with the reproducibility-first approach followed throughout.
